# console-1.2 run on-lists: Friends list and leaderboard views (read only)
# np-player.txt written by 1.3.0 build console-kit (the kit's files are not old settings files: the stale-settings guard leaves them as they are)
# tier 3, group online24, route onlists, version payload 1.3, role ab
# (e) read-only views: the hub's FRIENDS (friends list) and RANKINGS (leaderboard) screens; nothing is written (the login's own rank put is the only POST besides the reads). PASS (tools/console-1.2/online_check.py <log> --run <id> reads it all): every STATE line of the route in order and `script exit`, no `[script] TIMEOUT`, no crash; the `[np-net] req` lines show every request ANSWERED by the service (an HTTP 2xx or the service's own JSON error with a code), no `trying the other address` line (either `[np-net]` or `[online]`: in an auto run one means the new address FAILED: report it), host=new on every request of an auto run, host=old in the old variant; at most 100 requests in any 10 s window (the zone's shared rule) and the requests per minute stay far below the service's daily budget; every pollScale / over_budget level / retryAfterSec the log shows is reported; the menu returns after the cancel. Needs a package built from agent/online24 (MSC_NET_REQLOG: before it the client logs no request line and the rules cannot be read).
